explanation: Track the increasing run ending at each position. Extend it only when the current value is strictly greater than the previous one; otherwise start a new run.
timeComplexity: O(n) A simple scan visits each pair once; skip-based implementations amortize backward checks against skipped starts.
spaceComplexity: O(1) Only indices, lengths and one best interval are retained.
attribution: Original C# implementation written for EPI Practice from the displayed contract; no upstream reference code copied.
correctness: The maintained length is the longest strictly increasing suffix ending at the current entry. It extends exactly when the latest adjacent pair increases; otherwise no earlier start can cross that pair, so the suffix restarts at length one. Taking the maximum suffix length considers every contiguous increasing subarray.
walkthrough: For [2,4,4,5,7], the first run reaches length 2. The equal 4 values force a restart; the final run [4,5,7] then reaches length 3.
edgeCases: A decreasing nonempty input has best length 1.
